Question ID: BIO_U01_L01_GP_Q01

Assessment focus: Use the stimulus exactly as written.

Plant GroupDaily LightAverage Height After 10 Days

B2 hours6 cm

Which statement is the strongest evidence that light amount is related to plant growth in this data set?

answer.text: Plants are alive, so light must always make them grow.

feedback.text: This choice does not use the stimulus evidence. Recheck the question, identify the mapped lesson skill, and connect the answer to the included stimulus.

answer.text: Group A received more light and had a greater average height than Group B.
